The tail never connected. Priya kept promising to fix it while the table waited with hands off the dominoes. "I've said 'fixing the tail' a lot and haven't finished it," she admitted. Leo found a gap just past the tip, and Maya spotted a separate break near the middle of the tail. Each patch seemed to fail.

Near the end, Priya tried moving the start onto the top arc, but the join into its mouth was still open when time ran out. Only 27 of 62 dominoes fell.

Everyone still called it a fish. The blind judges guessed a curved line, an arc of dominoes, a bent stroke. The team's honest check-ins, and Leo and Maya's careful inspections, were what kept the work moving to the last minute.
